title: Representation loss and hard-quantization loss separate
statement: For representation R(X), I_R=Var(E[s|R]) and I_q<=I_R<=I_full, so I_full-I_R is representation/oracle loss and I_R-I_q is hard-quantization loss when truth scores are available.

proof_location.section: O5. Representation loss and quantization loss separate
